comment: The debugger's builds (tools/dbg/ui/builds.mjs): the selector's entries, in order. scripts/build_site.py copies this table into the site and adds a build given by --build NAME=PATH[,ARG...]. `args` come before an example's own arguments in every launch.

builds.label: The specification
builds.description: The machine with every erratum at its default reading.

builds.label: The literal text
builds.description: The same machine with every erratum read as the text is written, so that a run stops where the text gives no answer. Three are kept at their default reading, because read literally they stop almost every program before it runs: CreateIntrinsicsAsyncArgument while the realm is set up, StringValueReservedWord at any identifier and CoveredNodeParent at any call or parenthesised expression.
